item.title: The founder's personal brand: why people buy from people
item.description: Two companies with the same service and almost the same price, and one sells more because people know its founder. When you need a personal brand, and how to build one without turning into an influencer.

item.title: Restaurant marketing: turning views into visits and orders
item.description: A video of your restaurant hit a hundred thousand views, and the dining room was half empty that same week. Why people watch and don't come, and what actually gets them to visit or order.

item.title: How to read your ads report: the numbers that actually matter
item.description: A report full of reach, impressions and clicks, and you still can't tell whether your ads work. Which numbers to read first, which to ignore, and what to ask whoever runs your ads.

item.title: The customer asks \"how much?\" and disappears. What's going wrong?
item.description: The most common message any business gets, and the conversation most likely to die. Why customers vanish after hearing the price, and how to reply so the conversation stays alive.

item.title: How to get your clinic on Google Maps when patients search nearby
item.description: A patient types "dermatologist near me" and picks from the top three. What decides your position on the map, and how to set up your clinic's profile step by step.

item.title: Why your followers aren't turning into sales
item.description: Thousands of followers, decent engagement, and sales that won't move. Where the path from follow to purchase breaks, and how to find the broken part in your business.
